messages:
Emma R: Hey team — we need to lock a postmortem for the outage yesterday (svc-auths 503 spike). Looking for a facilitator and to confirm attendees. I can run it if no one else can. Proposed slots (PT):

- Tue 10:00-11:00
- Tue 16:00-17:00
- Wed 08:30-09:30

Link to draft doc/pre-read: https://redwood-internal.notebooks/postmortem/svc-auths-2026-03-14 (please add notes). Goal: 60m, capture timeline, action owners, and follow-ups.

Jordan K: I can facilitate Tue 10 if that works. Haven't chaired one in a bit so happy to take.

Liam T: I can do Tue 16:00 slot and will handle the timeline section (have the pager logs). If Jordan's got 10 I'd back them.

Maya S: I prefer morning slots (Europe morning). Wed 08:30 PT works for me (that’s ~16:30 CET). Need to check calendar but tentatively in. Also please @mention any product folks who saw impact.

Oncall-bot: INCIDENT SUMMARY: svc-auths 503 spike — severity: sev2. Pager fired at 2026-03-14T18:13:02Z. Mitigation: rolled back config change at 18:27Z; traffic normalized 18:31Z. Impact: elevated error-rate for auth requests (~22% at peak) affecting login flows for ~12% of GA users. Links: https://rwinf-incidents/INC-3121, logs: https://rwinf-logs/app=svc-auths/query?q=503+error

Emma R: thanks bot. Jordan — if you take facilitator, can you also own inviting product and support? Ping @Maya S and @Liam T as TLs. We should get the PM (Alicia) and a support rep in to speak about customer impact.

Jordan K: I can invite Alicia and drop a calendar invite. Two quick asks if I facilitate: 1) can someone pre-populate the timeline in the doc? 2) can we have a short readout of customer impact (support) — maybe 5m agenda item.

Liam T: I'll paste a timeline snapshot into the doc by EOD. It’ll include paged-on, mitigation steps, and error-rate numbers.

Maya S: Support rep is Priya — I've added a note for her in the doc. Also suggest adding the config diff that rolled back (small YAML change) under artifacts.

Ops-bot: Calendar created: "Postmortem: svc-auths 503 spike" — tentative Tue 16:00 PT / Wed 08:30 CET. Invitees: Emma R, Jordan K, Liam T, Maya S, Alicia P, Priya R, SRE Manager. Add/remove via the event page: https://calendar.redwood/postmortems/1729803456

SRE Manager: Quick governance note — facilitator should ensure action items have owners and due dates (use the "pmr-actions" label in the doc). Also we need a short RCA summary by Friday EOD. Jordan, if you facilitate, please capture action owners during the meeting.

Emma R: Jordan sounds good. Jordan — go ahead and finalize Tue 16:00 PT if that gets the most hands. If people can't make it, we can record and do async reviews but try to have at least one Eng TL + Support + PM.

Jordan K: locking Tue 16:00 PT then. I'll drop the invite and agenda. Agenda draft: 1) Timeline (10m) 2) Customer impact (5m) 3) Root-cause hypotheses + data (20m) 4) Remediation & action assignment (20m) 5) Wrap/next steps (5m).

Liam T: ack — will add the timeline and include the kube events + request traces.

Maya S: ack for action owners — if we need a follow-up remediation runbook I'll volunteer to own that item.

Emma R: thanks everyone. Jordan, once invite is sent tag me and I'll post the pre-read highlight in #eng-oncall. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

Jordan K: Invite sent and doc updated with timeline snapshot. Tagging Alicia & Priya in the doc for impact notes. If anyone needs to swap slots or can't attend ping me here.

Emma R: FYI — opened action item template in the doc: `pmr-actions` table. Please add assignees + estimated due dates before the meeting if possible.

SRE Manager: Noted. Also suggest we run the automated regression eval against the auth service after the change to be sure the rollback didn't hide other issues. Assigned to Liam if that's OK.

Liam T: ok — I’ll run the regression eval and post results in the doc by Wed morning.

Oncall-bot: REMINDER scheduled: postmortem doc must be published to internal wiki within 7 days to satisfy compliance.

Emma R: Closing loop — picked facilitator: Jordan K; meeting: Tue 16:00 PT; pre-reads & timeline due EOD today (Liam), support impact notes (Priya/Alicia) please add by EOD tomorrow. See you all.
